articleTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: What It Means When Your Surgeon Skips the Smaller Surgery
imageHeadline: Your surgeon skipped microdiscectomy. Here's why.
imageSubtext: What it means when disc replacement is recommended first
pinTitle: Disc Replacement vs Microdiscectomy: Understanding Your Spine Surgery Options
pinDescription: When your surgeon recommends disc replacement over the smaller microdiscectomy procedure, it's telling you something specific about your spine condition. Learn what that recommendation means, what factors influence the choice, and the key questions to ask before deciding on surgery.
